notes: Sourced from Clear-Com's official HMS-4X Main Station datasheet (PDF), which includes an annotated front/back panel legend and full technical spec table. HMS-4X is marked by Clear-Com as a legacy product as of 2022 (not recommended for new designs, but still supported). Port notes: (1) The two "XLR Powerline" ports (Line 1, Line 2) are Clear-Com's proprietary Frequency-Modulated-Ethernet-over-XLR digital partyline links carrying audio, data, and ±29.5V DC to beltpacks/stations over standard 3-pin XLR cabling; each Powerline has one 3-pin XLR male and one 3-pin XLR female jack on the rear panel (represented here as a single bidirectional xlr3 port per line since they function as one logical send/return powerline pair). No "grade" applies since sdi/hdmi/dp/usb/eth scales don't describe this proprietary link. (2) The rear "Control I/O" port is physically a 25-pin D-sub (DB25) female connector carrying 4 optically-isolated GPIs and 4 relay GPOs (5V logic). None of the allowed connector ids is a DB25/D-sub type, so this was mapped to "rs232" as the closest available D-sub-style control connector in the allowed list — this is an approximation and should be corrected if a dedicated DB25/D-sub id becomes available; treat with lower confidence than the rest of the ports. (3) Front-panel USB Type-A and Micro-USB ports are explicitly labeled by Clear-Com as "factory service use" only, not general connectivity, but are included since they are physical I/O; graded usb-2.0 per the datasheet's "USB 2.0" / "Micro USB 2.0" front-panel legend labels. (4) The 3 rear "Option Module" slots accept optional HLI interface modules (2-wire, 4-wire, Ethernet HLI-ET2, Fiber HLI-FBS) sold separately — these are not populated by default and are therefore not listed as fixed physical ports; the base unit ships with these bays empty/blanked. (5) Headset and Gooseneck Mic connectors are on the front panel, not rear. (6) Power connector is IEC-C14 (fused), rated 100-240VAC 50-60Hz, 250W max — mapped to the "iec" id (C13/14 family).

ports.name: XLR Powerline 1
ports.note: Digital partyline (Frequency-Modulated Ethernet over XLR) carrying audio, control data, and ±29.5V DC to up to 10 user stations/beltpacks. Rear panel presents one 3-pin XLR-M and one 3-pin XLR-F jack for this line.

ports.name: XLR Powerline 2
ports.note: Second independent digital partyline, same characteristics as Powerline 1.

ports.name: Program In
ports.note: 3-pin XLR-F. Program audio line input, 0dBu nominal, +18dBu max before clipping.

ports.name: SA Out
ports.note: 3-pin XLR-M. Stage Announce line output, 0dBu nominal, +18dBu max before clipping.

ports.name: Hot Mic Out
ports.note: 1/4" (6.35mm) TRS jack carrying hot mic audio plus IFB mute signal.

ports.name: Control I/O
ports.note: Physically a 25-pin D-type (DB25) female connector with 4 optically-isolated GPIs and 4 relay GPOs (5V logic). No DB25/D-sub id exists in the allowed connector list; rs232 chosen as closest approximation for this D-sub control port. Treat this port's connector mapping as low-confidence.

ports.name: Headset
ports.note: Front panel 4-pin XLR connector for combined dynamic/electret headset mic input and headphone output. Mapped to xlr4-dc as the closest 4-pin XLR id in the allowed list (not DC power related in this application).

ports.name: Microphone (Gooseneck)
ports.note: Front panel 3-pin Tuchel connector for gooseneck microphone; mapped to xlr3 as closest equivalent.

ports.name: USB 2.0
ports.note: Front panel USB Type-A port, factory service use per datasheet.

ports.name: Micro USB 2.0
ports.note: Front panel Micro-USB port, factory service use per datasheet.

ports.name: Power In
ports.note: Universal power socket (fused), IEC-C14 inlet, 100-240VAC 50-60Hz, 250W max.
